assessment: This study dissects the complex Shh pathway to explain the phenotypic similarity between Lhx2 and Shh retinal knock-out mice. The authors use multiple converging experimental strategies to show Lhx2 activates the Shh pathway, mainly by up-regulating co-receptors Gas1 and Cdon in retinal progenitor cells. The experiments are creative, and the findings provide evidence that Lhx2 acts in a contextual manner and integrates signalling pathways, conferring enhanced Retinal Progenitor Cells with the competence to respond to Shh. The study provides novel and interesting views on retinal development.
